title: Notify when something in a pane is waiting on us
notes: Out of the app: a system notification when something needs attention, like a Claude session waiting on an answer. In the app: a small in-app notification, and highlight the tab that is waiting. Shipped: the packaged app is re-signed ad hoc so macOS registers it with Notification Center under the same name as its Info.plist, the banner is raised from main instead of the renderer, and a waiting project gets a pulsing red dot on its tab that stops pulsing under reduced motion. PR #13.
